stemBlocks: A circuit contains a $12\text{V}$ battery, a thermistor and a fixed resistor connected in series.

The graph shows how the resistance of the thermistor varies with temperature.
When the temperature of the thermistor is $10\text{°C}$ the current in the circuit is $25\text{ mA}$.
What is the current when the temperature of the thermistor is $80 \text{°C}$?

assets.alt: Graph showing resistance of a thermistor versus temperature.
